{{Conflicting|''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''|''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''}}
The '''Darkshear''',<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> also known as the '''spear of midnight black''',<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> was an arcane [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It enabled a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-user to channel the Dark in a sustained, directed burst.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" /> It could be used to forge an imperceivable melee weapon in the form of a piercing metaphysical spear of midnight black.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight" /> A Darkshear strike caused victims to suffer the cumulative damage of years of atrophy in a single moment. Armor rusts and becomes brittle, [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] drain, and machinery jams. Individuals can age thirty years in an instant, with vital body parts such as their heart, lungs, and joints failing in the midst of battle. Darkshear damage could sometimes be reversed with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], but might require [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] replacement.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />

The [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]'s unique [[Way of the Dark|perspective]] on the Force gave them access to many inordinate capabilities,<ref name="Imperial">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> such as Darkshear. They became masters of this arcane technique and used it in the rare event they were threatened with face-to-face confrontation.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />

==Behind the scenes==
The spear of midnight black first appeared in the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'' as the Force power that [[Kyle Katarn]] used to kill [[Boc Aseca]], where Kyle manifested it as a spear made purely of the Force.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight" /> Darkshear was mentioned in the supplement book [[The Unknown Regions|''The Unknown Regions'']] where it was described as one of the powers that the Sorcerers of Rhand mastered should they come into combat. With it's physical description being described as a sustained, directed burst of the [[Way of the Dark|Dark]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions" /> Later during the third part of ''[[The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire]]'' Darkshear was mentioned among the powers of the Sorcerers, with its description, a metaphysical spear of midnight black, confirming that the spear of midnight black and Darkshear were the same power.<ref name="Imperial" />

While this technique is not available in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'',<ref name="DFII">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> it is described in the novel ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'' as the method that Katarn uses to kill Boc.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight" /> However, in the game, Boc is killed simply by the lightsaber duel.<ref name="DFII" />
